tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the default: the invite opens dark, like a terminal.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: The invite card body, form fields, table and stat cells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (buttons, inputs, segments, steppers) on ground and ground-raised; at least 3:1 on both.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground and ground-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata on ground and ground-raised.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one accent: times, the invite hash, the primary button fill, selected segments. As text on ground, ground-raised and brass-soft.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brass text: the 'you are invited' tag, highlighted table rows.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a brass fill (primary button label, selected segment).

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: The identity colour. The arch of the invite card and the seal behind a guest's lattice. A field, not a text colour.

tokens.name: on-emerald
tokens.usage: Text on an emerald field, both themes.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Lattice lines and ornament on emerald and term-bg, both themes. Decoration only: never text on ground in Day.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal window and command echo background. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside the terminal: the title bar rule.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Typed text on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: The prompt, the caret and 'ok' on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Program output and comments on term-bg. 7:1 on term-bg, so dim still reads as body text.

tokens.name: veg
tokens.usage: The vegetarian mark (a dot in a square) on ground and ground-raised. Always with the word 'Veg'.

tokens.name: nonveg
tokens.usage: The non-vegetarian mark (a triangle in a square) on ground and ground-raised. Always with the word 'Non-veg'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface. On a brass fill the ring is on-brass instead.

groups.name: Invitation
groups.note: Fraunces, hosted by Google Fonts. The serif carries everything said from the heart.

styles.name: names
styles.usage: The couple's names, once per screen. The ampersand is italic.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings (.q-title). Always larger than anything inside the section.

styles.name: entry
styles.usage: Schedule entries, one step below the section heading.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: I am getting married, and I would love for you to be there.
styles.usage: The invitation text, in the first person of whoever sent the link.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: You reviewed my worst pull requests without judgment.
styles.usage: The personal line written for one guest. Italic, never more than three lines.

groups.name: Machine
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, hosted by Google Fonts. Mono carries everything the system says: commands, labels, facts, numbers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Facts on the card: date, time, venue, counts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal lines, the command echo, table cells, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tags and table headers. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: Amiri, hosted by Google Fonts. Used for the Bismillah only; set lang=ar and dir=rtl.

styles.name: bismillah
styles.usage: The Bismillah at the head of the invite card. Nothing else is set in Arabic script.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: tag padding, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, terminal bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Terminal body padding, schedule row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on the card.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of the invite page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of the page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, segments, tags. Crisp, like a terminal.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The terminal window, tables, stat grids, the foot of the invite card.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The two top corners of the invite card only, making the arch. Half the card's 380px width.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The invite card and the terminal window. Nothing else casts a shadow.
